People: Elias Lönnrot (other, Wikidata Q153159), died 1884; John Martin Crawford (translator, Wikidata Q6246984), died 1916. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Lönnrot, Elias, 1802-1884 [Compiler]; Crawford, John Martin, 1845-1916 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Kalevala, the epic poem of Finland, Cincinnati, The Robert Clarke company, 1904, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/kalevalaepicpoe00crawgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 73%, 100%, 93% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Elias Lönnrot, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
